description: Closed-aircraft source of truth after the latest model run. Use this file for UAV specs; resolved_configuration.json also contains template/calibration seeds that are not closed-run values.

model.name: H2AIR Integrated Model
model.description: Single-entry H2AIR model with separated user inputs, automatic lifting-surface sizing, measured linear-mass manufacturing model, polar-based airfoils, CAD export, discrete hardware selection and IE-SOAR cross-fuselage cooling integration.

run.fidelity_note: Integrated-v4 closure/optimization is screening fidelity. Airfoil polars are used directly where supplied; missing airfoils retain explicit screening fallbacks. Selected motor/prop/battery data remain subject to supplier/bench validation and pusher forward-flight correlation.

vertical_gust_screen.note: Sharp-edge vertical-gust screen with no gust-alleviation credit; conservative screening assumption, not a certification gust analysis.

main_wing.note: Screening polar approximating NACA 6415 at Re 2e5 (alpha0~-5, CLmax~1.55 in polar; CLmax_screen 1.37 for area sizing). Replace with measured/XFOIL at flight Reynolds before design freeze.

horizontal_tail.note: Uses the user-supplied XFOIL polar table directly. Values outside the table alpha range are clamped, not extrapolated.

vertical_tail.note: Uses the user-supplied XFOIL polar table directly. Values outside the table alpha range are clamped, not extrapolated.

mass.source: Printed fuselage nose fairing ~1.2 kg/m2 skin equivalent (0.8 kg/m)

main_wing_shell.source: Printed wing shell 1.8 kg/m2 planform (confirm with weighed print segment); 15% root thickness

horizontal_tail_shell.source: Printed HT shell 1.8 kg/m2 planform (confirm with weighed print segment)

vertical_tail_shell.source: Printed VT shells 1.8 kg/m2 total planform (confirm with weighed print segment)

carbon_fiber_tubes.note: Primary load-carrying CFRP tubes are auto-sized by the structural solver on an even-mm COTS-style screening grid and fed back into mass/CG closure. Secondary spars and fuselage longerons remain user-defined below.

detail.warning: Supplier fan airflow/static-pressure data are not available in the supplied IE-SOAR documents; airflow PASS/FAIL therefore uses explicit engineering-assumption fan capacity and must be replaced by supplier or bench data.

notes: AUTO selection is a database screening step. Final propulsion release requires measured thrust/power/thermal data at the selected voltage and propeller.
Battery current screen conservatively assumes simultaneous maximum lift + pusher database power.
Aircraft bus ceiling is 48.0 V (fuel-cell max); hardware bus_max is capped accordingly (not 12S×4.2=50.4 V).
